verdict.rationale: Firstbase publishes a flat registered-agent price of "$299 per state/year" on its registered-agent page, repeated on the Agent plan card as "$299.00 Annually · Per state". That is a published flat annual rate, and it implies the same amount recurs each year. However, the renewal terms are never stated explicitly. missing for 10: explicit statement that the renewal price equals the first-year price (no intro/promo distinction or price-change terms), independent or hands-on confirmation of actual renewal charges.
